svg.title: The last ten nights with your children

text.tspan: From the “Family Ramadan” program in Al-Morabbi
A short family night: ten to twenty minutes, depending
Prayer, du'a and Quran. Little ones join early and sleep on
time; older ones carry on if they wish.
Two short rak'ahs at home; the child chooses his place in
Du'as for yourselves, your family and people in need;
parents write for the little ones.
Bright lights off, phones away, and a calm recitation
of a short surah you know.
Everyone writes a hope for the coming year and puts it in
Choose two Ramadan habits to keep after Eid, on
One parent ends by making du'a for each child by name.
Al-Morabbi — an Islamic parenting companion, pregnancy to 18
